scenes.title: The Pie Thief
scenes.card: A baker’s giant pie vanishes before the village contest, and the trail of small footprints leads to a very different kind of thief.

scenes.title: The giant pie
scenes.card: A baker proudly shows her giant cherry pie. Today she will try to win the Golden Spoon.

subtitles.text: Rosa: Tilda! It is the biggest pie I have ever seen!
Tilda: Cherries and cream. Three days of baking.
Rosa: And today the mayor tastes it?
Tilda: At noon. And I will win the Golden Spoon!

scenes.title: The contest table
scenes.card: The pie is displayed in the village square. Everyone must wait until noon.

subtitles.text: Mayor Orin: Friends of Applewick! At noon the Golden Spoon goes to the finest pie.
Gus: Finest pie, finest pie. My stomach has been rumbling since breakfast.
Mayor Orin: Magnificent! Nobody touch it until noon.
Gus: Who, me? I would never.

scenes.title: Alone with the pie
scenes.card: Everyone leaves the pie alone for a moment. Gus is tempted, but his anvil calls him away.

subtitles.text: Tilda: Oh no. I forgot the red ribbon! I will be back in a moment.
Mayor Orin: Rosa! I need help with the judges chairs.
Gus: Cherries. Warm cherries. Just one little sniff.
Mayor Orin: Gus! Your anvil is ringing! Customers!

scenes.title: A small thief
scenes.card: Little Pip secretly takes the pie. He has a reason: his grandfather is hungry.

subtitles.text: Pip: Grandfather has not eaten for two days. Forgive me, Tilda.

scenes.title: The pie is gone
scenes.card: Tilda returns with the ribbon. The pie has vanished.

subtitles.text: Tilda: No. No, no, no. My pie! My Golden Spoon pie!
Tilda: Help! Somebody took my pie!

scenes.title: Who took it?
scenes.card: Everyone blames Gus, until Rosa notices small footprints leading away.

subtitles.text: Mayor Orin: Gus! You were sniffing the pie. I heard it from the anvil.
Gus: I only sniffed! I would never take it.
Tilda: Nobody else loves pie like you, Gus.
Gus: This is a terrible thing to say about a blacksmith!
Rosa: Wait. Look. Small footprints in the dust. Little ones. Going east.
Gus: Small! Do I look small?
Mayor Orin: Follow them! The contest is at noon.

scenes.title: Following the footprints
scenes.card: The four follow the footprints and cherry crumbs out of the village and toward the shepherd’s hill.

subtitles.text: Rosa: Here. A cherry crumb.
Tilda: He ate my pie on the way?
Mayor Orin: A thief with small feet and a big appetite.
Gus: Hungry thieves go uphill. I would.
Rosa: The prints climb the shepherd’s hill.

scenes.title: Grandfather’s hill
scenes.card: Pip gives the pie to his hungry grandfather, who realises it belongs to someone else.

subtitles.text: Pip: Grandfather, eat. It is a cherry pie.
Old Fen: Pip. Where did you get such a beautiful pie?
Pip: From the village. It was for the contest. You were so hungry.
Old Fen: Oh, little one. A hungry belly does not make a pie ours.

scenes.title: Caught
scenes.card: The searchers arrive. Pip admits it, and old Fen explains he has been starving.

subtitles.text: Tilda: My pie! Who took my Golden Spoon pie?
Pip: It was me. I am sorry.
Old Fen: He took it for me. I have eaten nothing for three days. My sheep ran off and I could not leave the hill.
Gus: And I was nearly arrested for pie.

scenes.title: Forgiveness
scenes.card: Tilda forgives Pip. Gus offers to find Fen’s sheep, and everyone invites Fen to the square.

subtitles.text: Tilda: Three days without food. And you still left half for the sheep.
Old Fen: Only half. The rest is for Pip.
Tilda: Pip, a pie is for eating. Next time, just ask.
Pip: Yes, Miss Tilda.
Gus: I will fetch your sheep, old man. They are afraid of nothing but my hammer.
Mayor Orin: Then come to the square, everyone! The contest goes on!

scenes.title: The Golden Spoon
scenes.card: The mayor gives the Golden Spoon to Tilda for her kindness, and Old Fen is served the first slice.

subtitles.text: Mayor Orin: Neighbours! This year the Golden Spoon does not go to the biggest pie.
Mayor Orin: It goes to the kindest baker. Tilda, who forgave a hungry boy.
Gus: And I get the first slice, because I was blamed!
Tilda: The first slice is for Old Fen.

scenes.title: A new apprentice
scenes.card: Tilda makes Pip her apprentice. The village is happy again.

subtitles.text: Tilda: Pip, I need a helper in the bakery. The ovens are warm and the cherries are free.
Pip: Me? An apprentice baker?
Tilda: Every day. And the first lesson: always share.
Old Fen: Now that is a pie worth stealing.
Gus: Never again. I am keeping my nose to the anvil.
